mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 5-year moving average signals accelerating demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above trend does not precede positive SPX returns in at least 70% of cases over the next 3 years, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals tight labor markets, which compresses wage growth and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings disappoint.
failure_condition: If UNRATE below 4.5% does not precede negative SPX returns in at least 60% of cases over the next 3 years, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as risk premiums widen.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS above 4.5% does not precede negative SPX returns in at least 60% of cases over the next 3 years, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.03 in any 2-year window.
